name: lab_asap7_gcd_compact_pkg
description: Leftover-named compact chip-package ladder for lab ASAP7. Not C4. Not Touchstone. Not a product win. Vdd is ASAP7 TC (0.70 V), not Nangate 1.1 V.

die.comment: Educational lump for an ~9 µm ASAP7 gcd die. I_die comes from live finish power / Vdd.

leftover.c4: dummy 2×2 bump LEF, not JEDEC C4
leftover.touchstone: lumped RLC only; no board S-parameter
leftover.cpa: compact ladder, not Ansys CPA / foundry package model
